gen-gf-gugi-gf-geist: Tall lowercase, bold attitude: that's Gugi, all up top. Geist then keeps a level beat in its sans-serif text, so long paragraphs settle into solid blocks rather than skylines.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-georama: Distinctive from the first glance, Gugi draws pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin. But Georama, with a c pulled apart like a bracelet, does the quiet carrying while Gugi grabs the eye.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-gidole: Tall lowercase, open-cut terminals, plenty of nerve: Gugi is hard to miss up top. And Gidole, the sans-serif beneath, keeps its terminals apart like scissor blades, so the two sit together without crowding.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-golos-text: Approachable describes Golos Text, a sans-serif with an x-height that fills the line, set beneath the tall, bold Gugi. Shrink Gugi to small sizes, though, and it loses its punch.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Approachable, Hedvig Letters Sans leaves a clear wide gap where the c ends, set under bold Gugi. And line after line, its lowercase standing nearly as tall as capitals keeps the text flowing without lurching.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-heebo: Gugi writes like a pen that never changes pressure or angle, with lowercase nearly meeting the capitals. But Gugi earns its keep big and short, while Heebo, a sans with a tall central band, handles everything else.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur is a modern sans, its lowercase like stamped metal type, its strokes like steel cable. Gugi handles the loud moments, while Hind Guntur does the steady work of carrying the words.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-hind-madurai: Gugi brings tall, bold lowercase with open-cut terminals, while Hind Madurai, a sans, fills lines with lowercase like capitals. Its s curves open wide at both ends, so paragraphs flow.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-hind-mysuru: Lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals makes Gugi unmistakable, while Hind Mysuru presses its own tops close to ascender height. Gugi grabs attention; Hind Mysuru quietly does the reading.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along in a flat gray, its sans-serif rounds gapping like a cracked bangle. And across a stretch of text, constant weight and a gentle bump up to capitals keep the eye moving under bold Gugi.
